notes.title: Changelog 1.5: Steam Deck Verified and Stutter Fix!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, thank you for your patience.

Big thanks to everyone who took the time and effort to find and report and bugs or issues, its helped us figure out what needs to be worked on very quickly and we appreciate it so much.

Below is the list of changes :


 General performance improvements
 Reduced camera stutter
 Added game over cutscenes to the Cutscene Gallery (May have to die again to unlock them) 
 Fixed dialogue speed being slow in some situations
 Fixed bug that could soft-lock you on the Map UI screen
 Replaced steam's Easy Mode option with an in-game menu for selecting a difficulty when starting a new game
Fixed the game completion icon not being visible at the defeat of the final boss (continue a save and re-save to see it)
 Changed the Easy Mode starter items
 Fixed missing Beatrix dialogue line when beating the game and completing every quest (Talking to her now will show you the line if you've already done the quests. Also, we're still planning to revamp the final reward given here)
 Various equipment UI fixes
 Various gallery UI fixes
 Various quest UI fixes (including scrolling not working in languages other than English)
 Various map UI fixes
 Various gacha collection UI fixes
 Attacks now play on button pressed instead of button release
 Fixed a bug causing the Long Distance Relationship quest to not appear as active or not give the quest item
 Removed weird sound playing when loading a save file
 Fixed bug that would show you had done every quest when you still had 1 to go.
 Reduced the chance of getting stuck on ground corners
 Automatically pause the game when the game's window loses focus
 Talking to Bad Boy after completing Long Distance Relationship quest now gives you 500 coins and plays a 'kaching' sound.
 Removed invisible damage dealing block in Tengoku
 Fix to prevent player's cheesing the Goblin Queen
 Fixed the stunned fx appearing on stunned enemies after killing them and re-entering their room
 Fixed duplicate stunned fx appearing on stunned enemies
 Increased the accuracy of Magnetic Hairpin magnetised objects
 Fixed the Ex-Boyfriend room door not staying open after unlocking
 Increased the damage done by the final charged ranged attack
 Fixed the Snapping Plant Enemy being able to attack during its death animation
 Fixed toxic slime puddles hovering above the ground slightly
 Added small fx to toxic slime puddles for when the player touches them
 Cleaned up the Jigoku background
 Improved ambience to Jigoku
 Added charge up sound to Ghost Boss beam
 Fixed Natasha's interact area being too high up 
 Fixed Dr. Witch Doctor missing some attack sounds
 Added a missing exit from Fungal Forest to the map
 Fixed the Tako Red Enemy hitbox not damaging the player correctly
 Updated Belle's cutscene
 Added a Mind Mushroom sound to the Heavenly Daikon room
 Fixed Pandora's beams rotating incorrectly
 Fixed Pandora's melee attack doing only a tiny amount of damage
 Fixed the large Chaos Witch midpoint cutscene not resetting her to her correct idle animation
 Fixed some beam sounds continuing to play their sound after a fight has ended
 Updated credits for voice actors and other contributors
 Fixed a missing interact animation for Rover


This is the 'final' big build for this year as we'll be taking some downtime to relax over Christmas, we'll be working on smaller things and adjustments here and there, but bigger stuff will be adjusted and added from Jan next year :)

notes.title: Development Update - July 2023 The release period update!
notes.content:
Dev Update
Hello everyone!

Sorry for the delay in updating.
It's been a busy few months but it's been productive!
We have nailed down a possible release period and we're ready to share that with you all!

We're currently looking at a release between Q4 2023 and Q1 2024 depending on how the next few months go.
Our current trajectory means we're aiming for early Q4.

We've built in a bit of buffer time into this period so you can expect us to make a more nailed down announcement within the next few months as we test and make sure the game is stable/not buggy and playable from beginning to end with no issues.

We're stuffing the game with as much content as possible before release so look forward to a lot of fun scenes and loops :) 

This game has a lot of love in all aspects from art, animations, vfx and music!
We've tried to make this as fun of an experience as possible and will use any feedback from this game for future projects.

We're excited to finally be able to have an end goal to work towards and hopefully that love and polish will shine when you all get to play it. 

Thanks for reading, 

Momo Team <3

notes.title: Development Update - February
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/4bca745add5b0f4e8e217b8c9230702bc32ae407.gifOverview
Hello again, thank you all for waiting and your patience.
We're currently all working really hard, so I hope you'll forgive the lack of polish on this update.
It feels like we're 'knee deep' in content right now and trying to finalise all these things takes a lot of energy.

We're getting into the final stages of the project and the end is in sight, but still not close enough for us to announce a date.

It's motivating to be at this point as we now just have a checklist of things to finish before we are comfortable announcing a release window.
I'll get more into details below.

Overall update

Over the past few months we have been working on bosses/quests. These are really the last things we need to finish before we can release.

The musician has reworked and polished some boss tracks since we have the time for it.

VFX for bosses are also being given an extra polish and some bonus VFX added. It's looking great!

The update is a bit sparse but really we just need to finish the quest animations, boss battles and polish up our levels to look prettier. 

We're going through each map to finalise them 1 by 1 and so any missing things that pop up during this process are being added as well.

While this does seem straightforward it's very time consuming so please don't get too hyped yet about a release date announcement.
We will announce our release date a few months in advance. So thank you for your patience again. We really appreciate it. :) 

Closing Notes
As usual we will be active in the community and answering questions when they arise.
We'll be working on our marketing strategy soon and then we'll be able to share a lot more info about the game and what you can expect.

Thank you for reading and your interest. 

- Momo Games

notes.title: Development Update - December
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/9212f0f541f5408e9f2c75da52696bdfad4a8682.gif
Holiday Greetings

Hello all, just wanted to make a quick post before the holidays.
Wishing you all a Merry Christmas/Happy Holidays, hope you all are taking care of yourselves and keeping warm.
Personally, we are celebrating Christmas and the team are taking a few days downtime to spend with their families.
So, during the week of Christmas development will slow down, but will be picked up again the week after.
This won't affect our progress, so please don't worry.

Now into the actual update stuff.

Development Update

We have been working hard to hit internal goals, so far we've hit all of them except 1.

We still have 3 bosses to finalise, but are rapidly approaching this point, so we feel our trajectory is doing well.

Our next goal is to piece everything together and test, so we should be able to share a lot more in the New Year.
Alongside this we are also trying to nail down our release date, we are not ready to announce yet but we want you to know that we are actively assessing our options as the game becomes a more final product.

Here's a quick list below of what has been implemented recently.

 Finalised and polished the first 5 bosses of the game.
 Added more particle effects that read better on screen.
 Finalised and polished the player costumes.
 Finalised a lot of Lucky Machine animations.
 Continued work on in game quests to unlock scenes
 Finalising story dialog
 Steam Deck testing (Yes, we got our hands on a steam deck, and plan to release with full support.)


Closing Notes

We just want to thank you for your patience as we continue development. We are doing our best to make this a fun and unique game. 
Thank you for waiting and see you in the New Year.
- Momo Games Team

Development Update
Hello all, sorry for the delay in updates! We were deep in development and honestly we were so engrossed in so many things we forgot how long it's been since the last one.

Here's an update on progress.


About 95% of all the enemy animations are finalised + polished (We have just a few small things until we're at 100%)
 By the end of the month all the player costume animations will be complete and polished, this months task was to try and finish all of those animations and we've made a lot of progress
We've also made a chunk of progress on boss battles.. with next months goal being to complete them all. 
We are doing a pass on VFX to make things feel even better than before. We have some amazing VFX that make Boss Battles / Items feel much more powerful.
Every quest scene is designed now and slowly being animated as we implement more of the quests.
Music! We have bonus music because at this point all the major tracks we needed are done, so we're just adding more to specific areas and events to make the game even better.
Implemented some new features that will make gameplay a lot more unique. These are 'small wins' that change gameplay significantly. 


Animations and pictures

Regarding a release date, we have 2 possible dates in mind but not sure which one it will be so we will see how development goes for the rest of the year.
We are really excited to get the game out as soon as possible but also don't want to jump the gun too much by announcing a date we aren't 100% sure of. 

Thank you again for your patience.
- Momo Games Team

notes.title: Dev Update and Release Date Change
notes.content:
Steam Page Change Info
Some of you may have noticed that we have changed the release date from 'Q2 2022' to 'Coming Soon' and we wanted to explain the reasons behind this change.
We also want to apologise since we no longer feel we can hit a Q2 release and we wanted to relay this information as soon as possible.

First of all, the team is still happy, passionate and motivated to work on the game which we feel is the most important. 
There is nothing to worry about, we haven't had any major shocks or changes that are going to affect development.

The major reason for this change is that we are currently implementing all the quests and scene content but these are taking a longer time than expected to do. 
We are looking at ways to speed up the process without affecting the quality.

Another reason is that we just don't want to keep people in the dark and suddenly announce that we can't hit specific dates. So the next time we announce a release date it will 100% be the date you can expect it to come out.
We feel that 'Coming Soon' reflects the game development more accurately now and that we are working on getting it released as soon as possible!

We're in a weird position where we almost have a full playable game but still have to implement a lot of the H-Content and we want to give as much love to that part of the game as we did the gameplay aspects.
Hopefully this will create a game that is a polished and enjoyable experience.

We will continue being active here and doing periodic dev updates too as well as answering any questions that pop up. 
We'll be upfront and honest about our development process so if you do have concerns please let us know.

Dev Update
On top of this, we just want to do a small dev update on things that have been happening.

We have finished animating all the enemies and bosses. They just need some polish before release to be considered 100% final.

Level design has had a bit of a polish and we added some smaller details to make the world and atmosphere of the game feel better.

We implemented a decent chunk of questlines and dialog from the first 3 areas of the game. We're just waiting for the scenes to finish being animated so we can implement them and finalise those quests.

Gacha animations! These are just fun simple loops so we're not worried about producing a lot of these before release.

We have almost all music tracks complete (We even added extra since we have time) and have started doing final SFX too. The game is sounding great!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/3da09d1e0856ed43dadfa47fcc3318c8da5ee4fa.gif
Thank you for reading.

notes.title: Thank you!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/62043b09286e0251f7afd58edb8b71185ced3b95.gif
Thank you!
Thank you to everyone who has shown interest in the game.
We plan to update the steam page with more info asap and share more what you can expect gameplay wise.

Game info
A rough overview is that you play as a FlipWitch who can flip between male and female allowing you to interact with NPC's and quests in different ways.
Alongside the main story (Worlds to explore, boss battles, dungeons etc) There is a puzzle solving element to find out how to unlock certain H-scenes by changing form and costumes and finding these NPC's in the world.

We also have a main 'hub' area where a lot of quests can be found that you can pursue in your own time.

The team has spent a decent amount of time making the gameplay and exploration feel fun and we hope that when we release everyone will enjoy what we have created.

Should you have any questions we will be active in the community and replying to discussions and comments. 

External Pages
If you want to follow us for smaller updates on twitter, the main developer page is here:
@momoeroge
The artist can be found on twitter here if you're interested in fun, sexy animated loops.

Thank you so much for your interest and support and we will continue to make the best game possible for you.
